provenance: x402 specification v2 section 5.5, Settlement and Refusal Identity Invariant, as proposed in x402-foundation/x402 pull request 3776 on branch spec/settlement-refusal-identity-invariant and not on main; checked against commit c207612 on 26 October 2026
the gap these cover was named by ruiruii in erc-8004/erc-8004-contracts#99 on 18 October 2026: each of the four evidence layers depends on an attempt identity that none of them defines
the section names these vectors as the interim normative home until a permanent location in the x402 repository is agreed
encodes: A changed amount kept under the same identity, so a price change disappears into a replay.
description: The settle path carries an amount of 2000 where ingress saw 1000, and resolves the identity of the original request. The clause requires a different artifact. This is the case where a buyer is charged twice the quoted price and the record set still reads as one ordinary attempt.
limits: The vector shows the collapse. Whether the buyer was actually overcharged depends on the ledger and is not measured here.
